findings.description: Direct review of all five current views and all six current pose renders shows the neutral skirt remains a sharply faceted bell with irregular pleats and a jagged underside. In crouch, front and side panels lift away from the bent thighs; in sit, most upper-thigh surface remains exposed and pleated side/rear panels flare out. Current pose-coverage evidence measures overskirt coverage at 36.72% left / 35.37% right in crouch and 28.59% left / 28.36% right in sit. The 354-vertex hem pin holds only neutral coordinates and does not establish bent-pose coverage.

Gray body-colored-looking patches and hard facets remain across the ivory chest and waist in front and posed views. Their cause is not established by the renders; visible surface quality is unacceptable and needs a separately measured diagnosis after the skirt response is isolated.

nextAction: Keep V176 rejected. The actual Cloth bake recorded 615 inverted fixed-fan triangles of 17,567 overskirt triangles, zero collapsed triangles, up to 40.9 mm vertex displacement, and a maximum triangle-area ratio of 23.67; neutral hem drift is zero only because 354 authored hem vertices are pinned. Sit overskirt upper-thigh coverage is 28.59% left / 28.36% right, versus 36.72% / 35.37% in crouch. Next isolate the skinned front-lap pose response against the target rig while holding neutral Cloth output and bodice unchanged; alter only front-lap geometry or weights, then rerun crouch/sit coverage and inspect neutral/crouch/sit renders. Fit, Shape Key, Unity/VRChat, package, and release remain unverified.
